title: No material signal from a routine status check
observation: A routine execution record reports activity but contains no validated capability change, decision, repair, or new evidence.
reconstruction: The record was reviewed for significance and compared with the available acceptance evidence; no warranted institutional change was established.
claim: No material institutional signal was warranted in this reporting window.

evidence.supports: The record contains activity only and no validated outcome.

warrant: Activity without a meaningful, evidence-bearing change does not warrant a communication signal.
uncertainties: A later evaluator or completed artifact could create a signal in a future window.
boundaries: Do not convert activity, engagement, or a heartbeat into progress or publication.
what_changed: No warranted institutional change was established.
why_it_matters: The no-signal result protects attention and keeps communication evidence-centered.
what_follows: Keep the item in its owning workflow and review again when a validated outcome or decision exists.
